Recursive Org Chart Traversal

HardProQuerying BasicsSubqueries & CTEsJoins

Using a recursive CTE, build the full org chart starting from the CEO (manager_id IS NULL). Show emp_id, name, department, manager_id, and org_level (CEO = 1, their reports = 2, etc.). Sort by org_level then name. Recursive CTEs are tested at Google and Amazon for hierarchical data problems.
